plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Montclair Fiber EDFA optical amplifiers. It reports uptime, chassis/radiator/pre-pump temperatures, PSU state, fan state and speed, optional optical power, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 1385).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis internal temperature of the Montclair EDFA in degrees Celsius (deviceInternalTemperatute). Readings outside -40..125 C and sentinel values are dropped.

metrics.name: radiator_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Amplifier radiator temperature of the Montclair EDFA in degrees Celsius (amplifierRadiatorTemperature). Readings outside -40..125 C and sentinel values are dropped.

metrics.name: prepump_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Amplifier pre-pump temperature of the Montclair EDFA in degrees Celsius. The raw amplifierPrePumpTemperature value is divided by 10 in the collector and rounded to 0.1 C. Readings outside -40..125 C are dropped.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power supply state of the Montclair EDFA (devicePowerSupply1Status / devicePowerSupply2Status), normalized to 1=normal (7) and 2=abnormal (critical 3). undef(1) is dropped and not stored.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Fan state of the Montclair EDFA (deviceFanStatus), normalized to 1=normal (7) and 2=abnormal (warning 5 or critical 3). unknown(1) is dropped and not stored.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Fan rotation speed of the Montclair EDFA in RPM (deviceFun1Speed / deviceFun2Speed / deviceFun3Speed). Values below 0 or above 30000 and sentinel readings are dropped.

metrics.name: amplifier_input_power_dbm
metrics.description: Amplifier input optical power of the Montclair EDFA in dBm. The raw amplifierInputPower value is divided by 10 in the collector. Values below -60 dBm or above +40 dBm are dropped.

metrics.name: amplifier_output_power_dbm
metrics.description: Amplifier output optical power of the Montclair EDFA in dBm. The raw amplifierOutputPower value is divided by 10 in the collector. Values below -60 dBm or above +40 dBm are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
